text.value: Laboratory Report

tr.th: Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:

tr.td: The urine analysis shows significant leukocyturia, bacteriuria, positive nitrites, and presence of E. coli >100,000 CFU/mL, indicating a urinary tract infection. Hematuria and mild proteinuria are also present. The low specific gravity may reflect dilute urine. No casts or ketones detected. Clinical correlation and appropriate antibiotic therapy are recommended.
